title: HPF AI Disclosure Schema
description: JSON Schema for HPF AI Disclosure metadata. Consultation proposal, not a final v1.0 commitment. hpf_taxonomy_version and hpf_classification are required when an HPF record is present. hpf_descriptors is a proposed, provisional field introduced in the 0.9 August 2026 taxonomy revision; it applies only to generative_ai records and its values are consultation terms subject to change before v1.0. Descriptor meanings are defined by the taxonomy version named in hpf_taxonomy_version, so a stable value has a stable meaning for a given taxonomy version. Where no HPF declaration exists, omit the record entirely rather than writing null field values. Published by Human Provenance in Film under CC BY 4.0.

hpf_taxonomy_version.description: The version of the HPF Taxonomy applied to this record.

hpf_classification.description: The HPF disclosure category for this production. Derived from a signed producer declaration held in the chain of title.

hpf_descriptors.description: PROPOSED and PROVISIONAL. Consultation field introduced in the 0.9 August 2026 taxonomy revision. Applies only to generative_ai records. Identifies the type or types of generated content present. It does not determine classification, carries no threshold, and does not apply to no_ai or assistive_ai records. Values are provisional and may change before v1.0.
